subject: Energy
title: Quantum Batteries
description: A micro-lesson that makes Quantum Batteries usable.

hook.text: Quantum batteries exploit quantum entanglement and superposition—theoretically charging faster as they get bigger.

buildup.text: In classical batteries, charging time scales linearly with size—quantum effects could make it scale sub-linearly.

discovery.text: Researchers demonstrated quantum charging advantage in photonic systems—entangled photons charged a quantum cell faster.

twist.text: Practical quantum batteries are decades away—maintaining coherence at room temperature remains unsolved.

climax.text: The concept challenges our understanding of energy storage—at the quantum boundary, physics works very differently.

punchline.text: Entangled energy—quantum batteries are physics fiction, for now.

quiz.question: What theoretical advantage do quantum batteries offer?
options: Faster charging as they get bigger
